correctness.rationale: Counting ordered pairs means choosing x and then y=s−x. For s=0 every unit x gives z=0. For v_p(s)=a with 1≤a<k, z=s/(xy) has valuation a and the equation reduces after dividing by p^a to x(s−x)=s₀/z₀ modulo p^(k−a). Its mod-p roots are unit square roots of −s₀/z₀; simple lifting gives two roots for exactly half the unit z₀, and each root has p^a lifts. For unit s, the discriminant s²−4s/z ranges bijectively over residues outside one nonzero mod-p class, and every root gives a unit pair since the product s/z is a unit. A nonzero discriminant of even valuation 2j with square unit part has 2p^j roots: after dividing the root by p^j there are two simple roots mod p^(k−2j), each with p^j free lifts. The zero discriminant has p^floor(k/2) roots, and the omitted class subtracts p^(k−1) unit-square discriminants. This also covers p=3, where the unit-square stratum is empty. Squaring and counting gives m² at s=0, 2m² per nonunit valuation layer, and p^(k−1)[(k+1)(p−1)−3] per unit s (use the two parities of k). Adding these gives the stated E(H). Two-coordinate character orthogonality supplies exactly N²; division by m⁴ gives the displayed normalized expression under counting measure.
residual_risks: Analytic conclusion for ordered pairs at odd prime powers k≥2. No assertion for even moduli, arbitrary input weights, or the sharp extension operator norm. Finite archived diagnostics do not establish the unrestricted result.

evidence: For ℓ≥2 the theorem gives S₄(p^ℓ)=3 φ(p^ℓ) p^(2ℓ) for odd p. At ℓ=2 the correction sum excludes i=0 and 1 and i=2 is not congruent to either modulo an odd prime. K(1,b) is real by x↦−x, so fourth powers are absolute fourth powers.

For the two-parameter moment M_k, summing rows with unit first coefficient gives φ(p^k)S₄(p^k) by variable scaling. A nonunit first coefficient and unit second coefficient give zero by swapping and summing over last-digit shifts of x (the phase derivative is a unit). When both coefficients are divisible by p, each reduced unit x has p lifts and yields p⁴ M_(k−1). Over F_p the zero row has size p−1, and each unit row has one discriminant-zero fiber of size 1 and (p−3)/2 of size 2. This gives M₁=3(p−1)(p−2)p² and the recurrence yields the displayed M_k exactly.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Credit prior coverage of the entire aggregate, not just its unit-u part. The recurrence does not yield the complete distribution across z at fixed s; the valuation and discriminant enumeration supplies that distinct content.

The odd-modulus inverse graph is centrally symmetric. Replacing y by −y in D₁(s,z), the mixed-energy record's ordered difference fiber, gives precisely r(s,z). Its proof includes the origin, unit discriminant formula and nonunit Legendre-symbol formula.

originality.rationale: Pass is for the complete valuation-stratified ordered representation census at the frozen publication date, not for the aggregate fourth moment or the root-counting machinery. The total fourth moment is mechanically recoverable from an earlier one-coefficient moment theorem by a conductor decomposition. Two distinct later catalogue records give exact coverage of the census, one directly and one after sum/difference conversion; this is evidence of overlap, not a claim about first discovery or dependence.
residual_risks: An earlier exact reformulation of the whole census in inaccessible or differently indexed literature cannot be excluded. Later full coverage is documented but independent discovery or earliest priority is not established. The frozen prior-work comparison should acknowledge that the Gong–Veys–Wan aggregate implication extends to the full two-coefficient fourth moment after recursion.

value.rationale: The full representation spectrum records how collision multiplicities change between unit sums, each nonunit valuation and the zero sum. It contains information lost by summing squared counts, including the singular zero-discriminant fiber and the absence of ordinary unit-square fibers at p=3. This gives exact benchmarks for additive questions on a standard modular curve. The value is the census, not re-evaluating a covered aggregate or asserting a general restriction norm.
residual_risks: No asserted improvement in arbitrary-input estimates or extension to even residue characteristic.
